task: G3b (2026-11-12): FAA Form 5010 Airport Master Record for HWD - based aircraft by class, annual operations (local/itinerant), tie-downs/hangars
status: NOT OBTAINED: based-aircraft counts and annual operations could not be read from an official FAA source by automated access. Nothing below is a 5010 count.

attempts.result: HTTP 200, but it is the shell of an AngularJS app (ADIP). Its data come from POST https://adip.faa.gov/agisServices/public-api/getAirportDetails and .../generate5010Pdf with the body {"locId":"HWD"} (routes read from the app's own scripts, ng-shared/services/agisServices.js). Both answered HTTP 400 "Missing request header 'Authorization'". The app's script publicApp.js adds 'Authorization: Basic ' + AGIS.PUBTOKEN + '-ADIP' to every request. Copying that header into a script was NOT done (owner's etiquette: no header tricks). The page also loads Google reCAPTCHA.

HTTP 200: FAA NFDC airport display, data effective 10/29/2026-11/26/2026 (summary, operations, communications, NAVAIDs, weather, runways, charts, contacts, remarks). It has NO based-aircraft or annual-operations section. Its hidden 'This airport has an active construction notice' banner is only shown when HWD appears in /xwiki/bin/get/NFDC/Construction+Notices; that URL returned HTTP 404, so there is no evidence of a construction notice.

HTTP 200, 8,502,128 bytes, sha256 6e1e422f483d44cc8a38a1c97cf98e97588a6fc3fa857b39b5bdcbcfe8331154. None of its CSV files has a based-aircraft or operations column (APT_BASE.csv has 90 columns; checked for BASED / _OPS / ENG_CNT / OPERATIONS).

HTTP 200: FAA ATADS (Air Traffic Activity System): operations counted by FAA towers, by airport. It is a multi-field form application; not queried in this task. Possible source of tower-counted local and itinerant operations at HWD (an FAA ATCT); whether the 5010 operations figures come from it was not verified.

unverified_elsewhere: The City of Hayward figure of 206 leased hangars and 116 tie-downs (search snippet, source page 404) remains unverified (docs/PLAN.md section 1).
manual_route: Owner, in a browser: open https://adip.faa.gov/agis/public/#/airportData/HWD and use 'Download 5010 Form' (app route #/5010pdf/HWD). Save the PDF as hwd3d/refs/cache/faa/faa_5010_HWD_<yyyy-mm-dd>.pdf (US Government work, public domain) and add a SOURCES.json entry. Expected on that form (from the general Form 5010-1 layout, NOT verified in this session): based aircraft by class (single, multi, jet, helicopter, glider, military, ultralight) and annual operations (air carrier, air taxi, GA local, GA itinerant, military).
